recipe.partition: Official nuScenes train/val scenes; disjoint acquisition logs
recipe.input: Complete original measured returns; no point removal by semantic label or supervision range
recipe.supervision: 18 admitted normal classes within 2.5-50 m; unresolved categories ignored; no positive labels
recipe.supplemental_normals: Exact reviewed native point indices only; no category-wide or temporal label propagation
recipe.validation: Normal-field and false-positive analysis only; anomaly metrics require later positive examples
